prompt:

No people, foreground characters, NPC identities, text, lettering, UI, borders, labels, numbers, stat values, map coordinates, logos or game symbols.

A half-submerged ruined stone doorway has an old rusted iron mooring ring anchored conspicuously above its opening; faded natural tide-stain bands lower on the wall are now submerged. No text or drawn measurement lines. Landscape desktop composition: salt branches and ring/doorway grouped at left/center, orchard trunks receding through water, quiet mist and slate water along right quarter for future inspector. No fruit harvest, boats, people or magical sky; faint muted amber dusk.
Orientation: wide landscape. Full-frame opaque background, text-free.
